home.title: Unjiniyela Omkhulu Ogcwele Isitaki | Umkhiqizo Nezinhlelo
home.footer: Iwebhusayithi manje isihunyushwe futhi isitholakala ngezilimi ezingu-100+!
home.descriptionA: Unjiniyela omkhulu onesitaki esigcwele esineminyaka engu-6+ yesipiliyoni ethatha imikhiqizo isuka ezidingweni ezingacacile iye kumasistimu okukhiqiza athembekile. Ngiklama izakhiwo ngemuva kwezinhlelo zokusebenza ze-React, Angular, .NET, Node.js, Java, C#, Go, ne-SQL: imingcele yesevisi ecacile, amamodeli edatha aqinile, amaphethini okufinyelela avikelekile, kanye amathimba ezindlela zokulethwa angasebenza ngokuzethemba.
home.descriptionB: Umsebenzi wami uxhumanisa izinqumo zobunjiniyela nemiphumela yebhizinisi. Kusukela ku-SaaS elinganisela ukwakhiwa eshintsha idatha yesipredishithi ibe iziphakamiso ezilungele amakhasimende ukuya kumapulatifomu ewebhu angenisa imali, ngakha isofthiwe ezungeze ukuhamba komsebenzi, ubungozi, kanye inani elilinganisekayo elibalulekile kubantu abalisebenzisayo.

featured.title: Imisebenzi ekhethiwe
featured.description: Amaphrojekthi ayisithupha amelela kangcono ukuthi ngiguqula kanjani imibono ehlakaniphile ibe isoftware ephucuziwe nephumelelayo.

atlas.title: I-Atlas Yobunjiniyela
atlas.footer: Izizinda ezahlukene. Umkhuba owodwa wobunjiniyela oxhumene.

takeoff_engine.summary: Amashidi angahambisani angena. Izilinganiso zokwakha neziphakamiso ezilungele ikhasimende ziyaphuma. Umkhiqizo we-SaaS owakhiwe ngaphezulu kokuhamba komsebenzi kwangempela kukasonkontilaktha.
takeoff_engine.lens: Ukungena okuguquguqukayo kudinga imodeli yangaphakathi eqinile: ukwamukela amafomethi amaningi akufanele kubuthele imithetho yokubala okuncike kuyo ibhidi.

inventory_register.summary: Ukuhamba komsebenzi wendawo yokuthengisa nge-Angular ne-Node.js okuxhuma abasebenzisi abaqinisekisiwe, ukunemba kwempahla, nokuhamba kokukhokha okulingisiwe.
inventory_register.lens: Irejista yemali ingaphezu kwesikrini sokukhokha. Izindima, izinguquko zesitoko, nezimo zokukhokha zidinga imingcele ecacile ukugcina ukuhamba komsebenzi kunokubophezeka.

grocery_app.summary: Uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-.NET 9 Blazor elinemingcele yomlawuli, inkonzo, ne-community, ukuqina kwe-Entity Framework Core, nedijithi yokuhlola ephelele.
grocery_app.lens: Ukwehlukaniswa kuthola indawo yakho lapho imithetho yebhizinisi ingahlolwa ngokuzimele kwisixhumi esibonakalayo nesendlalelo sokuqina.

payrollobol.summary: Ukucubungula umholo kwe-GnuCOBOL kuhlangana nebhuku elikhulu le-SQLite elingena kabili nedeskibhodi yokusebenza ye-Svelte.
payrollobol.lens: Ukunemba kwezimali kuqala ngokumelela: izibalo zamacent avolileyo nokungenisa okulinganiselayo kukhanyisa ukuhamba kwemali.

interop.summary: Inkomba yezilimi ehlukene ehlanganisa izilimi eziyi-{languages} zokuhlela namaphethini ayi-{patterns} okusebenza, ehlola okwenzekayo emingceleni yesikhathi sokusebenza.
interop.lens: Ingxenye enzima isivumelwano phakathi kwezikhathi zokusebenza: ukushintshana kwedatha, ukuziphatha kwenqubo, nokusebenza okuphindaphindekayo kubalulekile kunesyntax.

formatter.summary: Injini yangempela yokuhlaziya i-Go ehlanganiswe ne-WebAssembly. Ukuqinisekisa nokuhlela kwe-JSON ne-YAML kusebenza endaweni yesiphequluli.
formatter.lens: Ukuhambisa i-parser kwisiphequluli kushintshana nomthwalo omkhulu weklayenti ukuze kucushwe endaweni, ukuthuthwa, nokuncika okuncane kweseva.

portfolio_website.summary: Isayithi okukulo: iphothifoliyo ye-React enezilimi ezingaphezu kwe-100, ukusebenzisana okufinyelelekayo, namathuluzi e-WebAssembly asebenzayo.
portfolio_website.lens: Ukuthunyelwa okungaguquki akusho okuhlangenwe nakho okungaguquki. Ukusebenzisana okunothile kungaphila kuklayenti ngaphandle kweseva yohlelo lokusebenza.

biblioteca.summary: Ipayipi lokufaka ulimi lwe-Python eliguqula umthombo owodwa wokuqukethwe okuhlelekile libe iphothifoliyo etholakala ngezilimi ezingaphezu kwe-100.
biblioteca.lens: Ukufinyelela emhlabeni wonke kuyinkinga yokugcinwa kwedatha kanye nenkinga yokuhumusha. Umthombo owodwa weqiniso ugcina izinguquko zokuqukethwe zilawuleka.

personal_summary.title: Isifinyezo Somuntu Siqu
personal_summary.text: Ngingunjiniyela omkhulu ogcwele isitaki esizinze e-Orlando, FL ongumnikazi wendlela esuka enkingeni yomkhiqizo iye kumphumela wokukhiqiza. Ngenza ukukhetha kobuchwepheshe kusevisi yesistimu: .NET kanye ne-Entity Framework Core uma isizinda esakhiwe ngokuqinile kanye nokubaluleka kokuphikelela okuhlolekayo; I-Angular noma React uma iyinkimbinkimbi ukuhamba komsebenzi kudinga isikhombimsebenzisi esigcinekayo; I-Node.js noma i-Go lapho i-API, ukuhlanganiswa, noma ithuluzi elisebenza kahle kakhulu lidinga isikhathi sokusebenza esigxilisiwe. Kuyo yonke imikhiqizo ye-SaaS, ukugeleza komsebenzi kwangaphakathi, nezinkundla ezibhekene namakhasimende, ngihola ngokuhwebelana okusobala, idizayini evikelekile neqinile, ukuhlola okuzenzakalelayo, nezinqubo zokulethwa ukusiza amaqembu ukuthumela isofthiwe ebalulekile ngaphandle kokushiya isikweletu sokusebenza ngemuva.

technical_skills.title: Amakhono Ezobuchwepheshe
technical_skills.no_samples: Ingxenye yamathuluzi ami okusebenza. Ngiyakujabulela ukuchaza indlela engikusebenzise ngayo.

entries.title: Ubunjiniyela Besitaki Esigcwele
entries.text: Ngihola ukulethwa komkhiqizo kusukela ekupheleni ukuya ekupheleni: ukuhumusha ukugeleza komsebenzi webhizinisi kumingcele yesistimu, amamodeli wedatha, ama-API, nezixhumi ezibonakalayo, bese ngiphatha umsebenzi ngokuhlola, ukuphakela, kanye nokuphindaphinda. Umgomo isofthiwe iqembu elingashintsha futhi liyisebenzise, ​​hhayi iqoqo lezikrini ezinqanyuliwe.

entries.title: I-Product & Platform Architecture
entries.text: Ngikhetha amaplathifomu namaphethini asekelwe enkingeni: amasevisi e-leyer .NET ezizinda zebhizinisi, izinhlelo zokusebenza ze-Angular noma i-React eziqhutshwa ingxenye yemisebenzi eyinkimbinkimbi, ehlobene amamodeli wedatha wokugeleza komsebenzi okuziphendulela, nokuhlanganiswa okuklanywe ngezindlela zokwehluleka, ukulawula ukufinyelela, nokugcinwa engqondweni.

entries.title: Ukulethwa Okulungele Ukukhiqiza
entries.text: Ngakha ngezinto ezingokoqobo ngemva kokwethulwa ngombono: izimfihlo ezigcinwe ngaphandle kokulawulwa komthombo, izindlela ezicacile zokuthuthela kusizindalwazi, ukugunyazwa okusekelwe endimeni, ukuqinisekiswa kwemingcele yesistimu, izivivinyo ezizenzakalelayo, ukuqwashisa nge-CI/CD, nokubonakala okungokoqobo. Lena imininingwane eshintsha i-prototype ibe isofthiwe ethembekile.

biblioteca.title: I-Biblioteca JSON
biblioteca.text: Ipayipi lendawo elisuselwa kuPython eliguqula umthombo wokuqukethwe owodwa ohleliwe ube iphothifoliyo efinyeleleka emhlabeni jikelele. Iphatha idatha yokuhumusha njengesistimu elondolozekayo esikhundleni sekhophi yekhasi eliyimpinda ngesandla, ivumela isayithi ukuthi lifinyelele ezilimini eziyi-100+ futhi yenze ukufinyelela emhlabeni jikelele amandla okusebenza esikhundleni sesici sesikhathi esisodwa.

connect_four.title: Xhuma Okune
connect_four.text: Umndeni omkhulu wokwenziwa okungaphezu kuka-{implementations} komdlalo we-Omine ngomugqa. Lolu hlelo luhlanganisa izilimi ezingaphezu kuka-{languages} zokuhlela, kuhlanganise ne-Java, i-C++, i-Python, ne-JavaScript, kanye nama-framework angaphezu kuka-{frameworks}, imithala, izikhathi zokusebenza, nezinhlaka zedatha ezahlukahlukene, kusukela ku-React, Angular, ne-Blazor kuya ku-Django, Spring Boot, Phoenix, PostgreSQL, nokunye.

grocery_app.title: Igrosa App
grocery_app.text: Uhlelo lokusebenza olugcwele lwe-NET 9 Blazor Server olubonisa ukwakheka kwe-backend okuhlosiwe kokugeleza komsebenzi webhizinisi. Ukuhlukaniswa kwesilawuli/isevisi/inqolobane kugcina imithetho yohlelo lokusebenza, ukufinyelela kwedatha, kanye nesethulo sihloleke ngokuzimela; I-Entity Framework Core inikeza ukuphikelela okuhlala isikhathi eside; kanye ne i-comprehensive test suite ivikela ukuziphatha njengoba umkhiqizo uguquguquka.

interop.title: Iphrojekthi ye-Interop
interop.text: Ireferensi yokusebenzisana kwezilimi ezihlukene ehlanganisa izilimi zokuhlela eziyi-{languages} namaphethini okusebenzisa angu-{patterns}. Iphrojekthi iphenya umngcele lapho amasistimu evamise ukuba ntekenteke: izinqubo zenkontileka, ukushintshaniswa kwedatha, ukuziphatha kwesikhathi sokusebenza, nezindlela eziphindaphindwayo zokuhlanganisa. Ibonisa ukucabanga kwesistimu edingekayo lapho umkhiqizo mkhulu kunesitaki esisodwa.

inventory_register.title: Irejista Yempahla
inventory_register.text: I-POS yesitaki esigcwele nokugeleza komsebenzi we-inventory eyakhelwe nge-Angular 17+ ne-Node.js. Imodela ukukhathazeka kokusebenza kohlelo lwe-B2B: abasebenzisi abagunyaziwe, ukulawula ukufinyelela okusekelwe endimeni, ukunemba kwe-inventory, kanye nokugeleza kwenkokhelo mbumbulu. Iphrojekthi yakhelwe emsebenzini wangempela owenziwa yithimba lerejista, hhayi nje ikhathalogi yezici zohlaka.

payrollobol.title: PayrollOBOL
payrollobol.text: Uhlelo lwasendaweni lokucubungula umholo olwakhiwe nge-GnuCOBOL, ibhuku elikhulu le-SQLite elingena kabili, nedeski yokusebenza ye-Svelte. Lisebenzisa izibalo zamacent avolileyo, ukucubungula umholo ngeqoqo, nedeskibhodi ye-loopback ukwenza ukuhamba kwezimali kucace, kuhloleke, futhi kube nokuzibophezela kokusebenza.

formatter.title: I-JSON & YAML Auto Formatter
formatter.text: Ithuluzi elisekelwe kusiphequluli le-JSON ne-YAML lokuqinisekisa kanye nethuluzi lokufometha elakhelwe ku-Go futhi lahlanganiswa ku-WebAssembly. Ukuhambisa injini yokuhlaziya iye ku-WASM kugcina ukusebenzisana kusabela futhi kwasendaweni esipheqululini ngenkathi usebenzisa umhlahleli wangempela ukuze ubambe okokufaka okungavumelekile. Kuyisibonelo esigxilisiwe sokukhetha ukwakheka kwesikhathi sokusebenza sokusebenza, ukuphatheka, nokwethenjwa komsebenzisi.

takeoff_engine.title: Injini yokuphuma
takeoff_engine.text: Isilinganiso sokwakha esilinganisa i-SaaS sakhelwe endaweni ebizayo, enephutha yokuhamba komsebenzi kasonkontileka. Umkhiqizo we-React + Express ungenisa idatha ye-CSV ne-Excel, ubeka amakholomu angahambisani abe yimodeli yesizinda esisebenzisekayo, ubala ukumbiwa kwemisele kanye namavolumu e-earthwork, ilandelela abasebenzi kanye umaka, futhi ikhiqize iziphakamiso ze-PDF ezilungele amakhasimende kanye ne-Word. Lobu ubunjiniyela bomjikelezo wokuphila womkhiqizo obugcwele: ukucozululwa kwedatha, imithetho yokubala, ukuhamba komsebenzi komsebenzisi okuphucuziwe, nokulethwa okusiza ibhizinisi lisuke kokokufaka okungavuthiwe liye kubhidi.

minecraft_json_generator.title: I-Minecraft JSON Generator
minecraft_json_generator.text: Ijeneretha ye-JSON engasindi eyakhelwe ePython yesisetshenziswa seMinecraft namaphakethe wedatha. Le phrojekthi isetshenziselwa ukukhiqiza amafayela e-JSON amamodi e-Minecraft, okuhlanganisa izinto zangokwezifiso, amabhulokhi, nezinhlangano. Iwusizo kakhulu ekudaleni ama-datapack ngokwezifiso kuphela, kodwa kuma-mods kanye nesici sokushintsha igama le-mod.

educational_experience.title: Okuhlangenwe nakho Kwami Kwezemfundo
educational_experience.text: Ngokuhambisana namaphrojekthi ami siqu, ngithole namakhono amaningi kokuhlangenwe nakho kwezemfundo. Chofoza lapha ukuze ubuke iphrofayela yami ye-LinkedIn ukuze uthole ulwazi olwengeziwe.

professional_experience.title: Ulwazi Lwami Lochwepheshe
professional_experience.text: Iminyaka eyisithupha nangaphezulu yomsebenzi wobunjiniyela obuchwepheshile kuwo wonke amaqembu omkhiqizo, izinkundla zebhizinisi, nesoftware ebheke amakhasimende. Umsebenzi wami uhlanganise ukwakha izendlalelo zezicelo ezigcinekayo, ukubambisana kuzo zonke izigaba zokulethwa, kanye nokwenza izinqumo zobuchwepheshe ngomjikelezo wempilo womkhiqizo, ukusebenza. ubungozi, kanye nobunikazi besikhathi eside kubhekwe.

portfolio_website.title: Patrick Goodwin Portfolio Iwebhusayithi
portfolio_website.text: Iphothifoliyo ye-React egxile ekukhiqizeni ephatha ukufinyeleleka nokufinyelela emhlabeni jikelele njengezidingo zobunjiniyela. Kuhlanganisa ipayipi elilondolozekayo lokuhumusha lezilimi ezingu-100+, amathuluzi asebenzisanayo asekelwa i-WebAssembly, amaphethini e-UI asabelayo futhi afinyelelekayo, kanye nesakhiwo sephrojekthi. yakhelwe ukukhula njengoba kuthunyelwa umsebenzi omusha.

lua_library.title: Patrick's Lua Script Library
lua_library.text: Ilabhulali ewusizo yemibhalo ye-Lua ukuze isetshenziswe esikhathini esizayo. Lo mtapo wezincwadi usetshenziselwa ukwenza ngokuzenzakalelayo imisebenzi emibhalweni ye-Lua, engaba usizo emisebenzini edinga ukusebenza, njengoba isiLua ngokuvamile siwulimi olusheshayo lokubhala ngaphezu kokubili kwePython neRuby.

excel_scripts.title: Patrick's Microsoft Excel Spreadsheet Scripts (VBA)
excel_scripts.text: Ilabhulali ewusizo yemibhalo ye-VBA ye-Microsoft Excel. Lo mtapo wezincwadi usetshenziselwa ukwenza imisebenzi ngokuzenzakalelayo kumaspredishithi e-Excel.

neovim_config.title: Patrick's Neovim Config
neovim_config.text: Ukucushwa kwami ​​​​kwe-Neovim yomuntu siqu. Le phrojekthi isetshenziselwa ukulungisa i-Neovim ngendlela engiyithandayo, okuhlanganisa ukuhlanganisa okhiye bangokwezifiso, izingqikithi, nama-plugin. Le phrojekthi isetshenziselwa ukwenza i-Neovim isebenziseke kalula futhi isebenze kahle kimina.

python_maps.title: Patrick's Map Generator
python_maps.text: Ithuluzi lokubika le-Python geospatial elakhiwe nge-GeoPandas ne-Matplotlib ukuze kukhiqizwe amamephu wesifunda sase-U.S. kanye nesifunda. Ishintsha idatha yendawo ibe ama-artifact afundekayo okuhlaziya, okubonisa umqondo wepayipi ledatha: khetha amalabhulali wesizinda alungile, yenza okokufaka kube ngokwejwayelekile, futhi ukhiqize imiphumela sekela izinqumo ezicacile.

powershell_library.title: Patrick's PowerShell Script Library
powershell_library.text: Ilabhulali ewusizo yemibhalo ye-PowerShell ukuze isetshenziswe esikhathini esizayo. Iwusizo ngesici seskripthi sephrofayela ye-$, ngithola lokhu kuwusizo kakhulu ekwenzeni imisebenzi esuka ku-terminal ye-Windows, njengoba ngingumsebenzisi ovamile we-Windows OS.

ruby_library.title: Patrick's Ruby Script Library
ruby_library.text: Ilabhulali ewusizo yemibhalo ye-Ruby ukuze isetshenziswe esikhathini esizayo. Iwusizo emicabangweni yokuthuthuka ye-Ruby on Rails.

pdf_builder.title: PDF Skills Builder
pdf_builder.text: Ukugeleza komsebenzi wokukhiqiza amadokhumenti okwakhiwe nge-Python, i-Pdfkit, i-Jinja2, i-HTML, nedatha ehlelekile ye-JSON. Ihlukanisa idatha engase isetshenziswe kabusha kuzifanekiso zokwethulwa ukuze kukhiqizwe kabusha i-PDF ehambisanayo ngokungaguquki, iphethini esebenzayo yokunciphisa umsebenzi wezandla nokwenza imibhalo yebhizinisi. okuphindaphindwayo.

rijandel_encryption.title: Iphrojekthi yokubethela ye-Rijandel
rijandel_encryption.text: Isethi yokuqhathanisa yokusetshenziswa kwe-Rijndael engu-{implementations} kuzo zonke izinhlobo ezingu-128-, 192-, kanye no-256-bit. Ukusebenzisa kabusha i-algorithm ezwela ukuvikeleka kuzo zonke izilimi kuwumsebenzi onesiyalo ekucacisweni okunembile, ukuziphatha okuhlolekayo, kanye nemikhawulo yokuphatheka kwezinga lolimi, wonke umzwelo owusizo wamasistimu aphatha idatha ebucayi.

suprememc.title: I-SupremeMC Minecraft Mod
suprememc.text: I-mod ye-Minecraft engeza amathuluzi akhethekile, izikhiya, izidalwa, amabhulokhi, ubukhulu, nezinye izici eziningi emdlalweni. Yakhiwe ikakhulukazi nge-Java ne-Kotlin, isekela izinguqulo ze-Minecraft 1.16 kuya ku-26.2.

snake.title: Umdlalo wenyoka
snake.text: Injini yeNyoka ephucuziwe yakhiwe nge-Rust ne-Macroquad, yahlanganiswa ne-WebAssembly, futhi yakhiqizwa nge-HTML5 Canvas. Ihlanganisa izinketho zomdlalo ze-0.12-second eziqinisekisiwe nokunyakaza okunambitheka okuhle, izigaba zomdlalo ezicacile, ukulawula okuphendulayo, ukuphatha ukushayisana nezimo zokunqoba, nedijithi yokuhlola egxilile ehlanganisa imithetho eyinhloko yomdlalo.

tiger_programming_language.title: I-Tiger Programming Language
tiger_programming_language.text: Ulimi lokuhlela lwangokwezifiso notolika olwakhelwe kokuthi Go ukuze uhlole umklamo wesikhathi sokusebenza solimi, ukuziphatha kokwenza, nokuhwebelana kokusebenza. Ukuyihlanganisa ku-WebAssembly nokuyihlanganisa kuphothifoliyo kwakha indawo yangempela yomkhiqizo, ebukekayo yobunjiniyela bezinga lezinhlelo kunokushiya umsebenzi isilingo senqolobane kuphela.

tiger_tailgating_pros.title: Iwebhusayithi yeTiger Tailgating Pros
tiger_tailgating_pros.text: Iwebhusayithi ye-React elethwa ibhizinisi lokuhlanganisa i-Clemson, SC. Umsebenzi uhumusha ukunikezwa kwebhizinisi elincane kube uhambo olucacile lwekhasimende kanye nokuba khona kwewebhu okuthembekile, ukusebenzisa ukucabanga komkhiqizo ukusiza inhlangano yangempela ukuguqula intshisekelo. ngemibuzo kanye nemali engenayo.

turing_machine.title: Iphrojekthi yomshini wokuthunga
turing_machine.text: Umndeni wezinto ezisetshenziswayo ezingaphezu kuka-{implementations} zoMshini weTuring. Isetshenziselwa ukukhombisa ukuphelela kwezilimi ezihlukahlukene zokuhlela ukuze kwenziwe ucwaningo, ikakhulukazi olimini lokuhlela lwe-Tiger.

alkalab.title: Alkalab
alkalab.text: Ilabhorethri yamakhemikhali yesihlabathi esimpuphu eyakhiwe nge-Rust futhi yahlanganiswa ne-WebAssembly. Penda isihlabathi, amanzi, i-lava, insimbi, i-calcium carbide, noma ucezu lwe-sodium ubone ukuthi i-physics nekhemistri zilwa kanjani: i-sodium iyagqabuluka emanzini, i-calcium carbide ikhipha i-acetylene, i-lava incibilikisa isihlabathi ibe ingilazi, futhi ukuminyana kuphela kuhlukanisa uwoyela, i-mercury, nesihlabathi. Injini isebenza ngezinto ezingama-32 nemithetho engama-40 yokusabela e-buffer yamaseli eyisicaba, ikhipha amaphikseli ngqo kumemori yomugqa we-wasm ngaphandle kwamakhophi ngeframe ngayinye.

contact.title: Thinta mina
contact.description: Ngiphendula imibuzo evela ku-imeyili kanye nemilayezo ye-LinkedIn. Ngizophinda ngishaye ucingo uma inombolo yami ihlinzekwe ngokuqalisa kabusha noma ngenye indlela, nakuba ngikhetha ukugcina inombolo yami yocingo iyimfihlo.

formatter.title: I-JSON & YAML Linter
formatter.description: Ithuluzi lekhwalithi yedatha elisekelwe kusiphequluli eliqinisekisa futhi lifomethe i-JSON ne-YAML kusetshenziswa injini ye-Go ehlanganiswe ku-WebAssembly. I-architecture ilokhu ihlaziya eduze nomsebenzisi ukuze uthole impendulo esheshayo, eyimfihlo kuyilapho isebenzisa imithetho ye-syntax yangempela emngceleni wedatha. Kuyisibonelo esihlangene sokuklama ukugeleza komsebenzi kanjiniyela okuthembekile mayelana nokulunga, ukusebenza, nokwethemba.
formatter.more_info1: Ukuze uthole ulwazi olwengeziwe, bheka i-README ku
formatter.empty_input: Sicela ufake i-JSON noma i-YAML ukuze uyixhume.
formatter.fixed_yaml_spacing: ⚠ I-YAML ibinesikhala/i-indent engavumelekile kodwa ilungiswe ngokuzenzakalela futhi yafomethwa.

tiger.title: Ulimi Lwengwe
tiger.description: I-Tiger iwulimi lokuhlela ngokwezifiso kanye nomhumushi we-Go eyakhelwe ukuhlola izakhiwo zesikhathi sokusebenza, i-semantics yolimi, nokuhwebelana kokusebenza. Ukuhlanganisa umhumushi ku-WebAssembly kushintsha ukuthi amasistimu asebenza abe umkhiqizo osebenzisanayo, osuselwe kusiphequluli: abasebenzisi bangakwazi ukwenza izinhlelo ngokuqondile kuyilapho isikhathi sokusebenza sihlala siphatheka. futhi ihlukanisiwe kuhlelo lokusebenza lomsingathi.
